description: Na₂VPO₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.83 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.55 Å. V is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.66-2.43 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 58-67°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.58 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one V atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one V atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to two Na, one V, and one P atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂VP tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one V, and one P atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₂VP tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one V, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one V, and one P atom.
